_comment: B96 — the GOLDEN eval question set. Pinned so the leaderboard is comparable ACROSS runs: with per-run
generated questions, every run was graded on a different exam, so a score delta measured question
difficulty rather than system quality (this confounded a real investigation on 2026-07-20 — run 5 scored
~0.30 below runs 3/4 across ALL SIX models at once, which reads as a system regression and was not one).
TWO HALVES, deliberately. The set exists to measure RETRIEVAL work (B74 hybrid BM25 + dense fusion), so it
must contain the phenomenon being measured:
conceptual (10) — prose/reasoning questions, carried over verbatim from run 6 so there is continuity with
the existing history. Dense embeddings already do well here; expect these to stay FLAT.
lexical    (10) — exact identifiers: ports, env vars, config keys, index names. This is precisely where
dense retrieval is weak and BM25 is strong. If B74 works, THIS half should move.
A single blended score would have hidden that contrast. Slice by `question_type` in eval_questions.
Every lexical term was VERIFIED present in the indexed corpus before being pinned (ilike count over
rag_chunks, source_type='markdown'). A question whose answer is not in the index scores zero for dense AND
hybrid alike and proves nothing. Rarer tokens were preferred — they discriminate best.
Editing this file changes the exam and breaks comparability with prior golden runs. Do it deliberately, and
note the change in docs/backlog.md (B96). To regenerate questions instead, set EVAL_QUESTION_SOURCE=generated.
